title: Why Byzantine Emperors Trusted Viking Axemen Over Their Own People (The Varangian Guard)
description:
For over three centuries, the Roman Emperors of Constantinople entrusted their lives not to Greek nobles or imperial legionaries, but to axe-bearing Norse giants from Scandinavia and dispossessed Anglo-Saxon warriors from England: the legendary Varangian Guard.

11:40 - Basil II's Wars: The Bulgars & The East
13:20 - Harald Hardrada & The Sicily Expedition
15:00 - The Revolt of 1042 & The Great Escape
16:40 - 1066 & The Anglo-Saxon Exodus
18:20 - 1204 & The Last Echo
